summary: vllm serve: port bound first, VllmConfig, EngineCore process, uni executor (no worker spawn on TP1; mp with 4 WorkerProcs on TP4), load model, profile, KV allocate, CUDA graph capture, then serve_http. Ordered path reproduced on TP1 and TP4. Notes: the busy loop is an emit so it appears after serve_http; the early port bind and the READY handshake are narration only.

Busy loop: idle iterations (notify idle callbacks, clear aborts, block on input_queue), ADD via the input socket thread, then step_with_batch_queue (async scheduling is the default, not step()), outputs over the ZMQ output thread with a one-step lag, idle again. The blocking get is a 1 ms poll (simulator).

Abort: OutputProcessor queues the final 'abort' output, ABORT goes over ZMQ, handle-abort, EngineCore.abort_requests, scheduler.finish_requests(FINISHED_ABORTED), kv_cache_manager.free, blocks back in the free queue; finish_reason 'abort' reproduced.

Corrected: the SIGTERM handler stops the engine client first (EngineCore SIGTERM, abort mode, loop exit, executor and workers shut down), then sets should_exit; with shutdown_timeout 0 on CUDA the manager SIGKILLs the engine-core tree after a 0 s grace. The engine-core side is reproduced on TP1. Missing: the API-server signal path and should_exit ordering, the force kill, and per-rank worker shutdown on TP4 (multiproc-executor.shutdown only sets a flag).

Corrected: the engine core runs in a background process (SyncMPClient), not in-process. Path right (adds 0,1,2, step until done). Outcome wrong: RequestOutput.request_id is the internal id instead of the external '0','1','2', token_ids hold 1 delta token instead of all 4 (FINAL_ONLY), llm.run-engine never sorts despite its claim, and per-prompt SamplingParams lists are dropped.

Corrected: the fan-out is in AsyncLLM.add_request (ParentRequest), and the children share only full prompt blocks through prefix caching. Fan-out and prefix sharing are reproduced (32-token hit = 2 full blocks), but each child gets its own collector, so generate (polling the parent id) never receives an output and returns finished=false; there is no ParentRequest aggregation.
